meta.caveat: There is no DAMOS for the 018CG. Conversion formulas are taken from 8D0907558E (Audi A4, M3.8.2, DAMOS 30N) while the channel list comes from FR 30O and the addresses from the 018CG image. Conversion names are shared across the M3.8 family, so the formulas are expected to apply, but this is a cross-image inference and has not been measured on the bench.
